Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 15

“Krishna blew his conch Panchajanya, Arjuna blew Devadatta, and Bhima, of terrible deeds, blew the great conch Paundra.”

Each hero's conch is named individually — a detail that gives even the instruments of war a kind of personality and mythic weight in this tradition.
